cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone blinked in the family photo. Before the next one, we'll do a blink rehearsal. Line up again, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just take three pictures quickly. One will be fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need to approve one expression, not sort through three accidents. I'll call 'blink', then 'hold'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The children will wander off before you finish explaining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you monitor the line. Count them after each rehearsal. Report 'all present' before I check their eyes; please don't give me two things to approve at once.
